title: Quality check of OpenStreetMap buildings, Jarir District, Riyadh

service.name: Spatial Data QA/QC and Accuracy Checks

data: OpenStreetMap buildings inside the Jarir District boundary (relation 13254462), downloaded through the Overpass API on 2026-11-20.
method: Download the buildings and the district boundary in one Overpass request and cache it.
Assemble polygons with the GDAL OSM driver and keep the buildings inside the district boundary: 2,285 footprints.
Run Madar Quality Checker: coordinate system EPSG:4326, empty, invalid and duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m², unique identifier, and completeness of the street name field.
Join issues.csv to the footprints and map each issue by type.
limits: OpenStreetMap is community data, so the case shows the checking method and does not judge the ground truth. Desk check of data consistency as downloaded. No check points, so no statement on positional accuracy or on buildings that are not mapped.
